postings.title: Customer Project Manager - European Space (m/f/x)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Join us as a Customer Project Manager (m/f/x) and help shape the future of space communications. In this role, you will serve as the key interface between our customers and internal project teams, ensuring customer expectations are aligned with project realities and that commitments are communicated clearly throughout the project lifecycle.

What awaits you at Mynaric

We are looking for a Customer Project Manager to support our Project Leads in the successful delivery of customer programs. Acting as the voice of the customer within the organization and the voice of the project towards the customer, you will help ensure transparent communication, timely issue resolution, and successful project execution.
You will work closely with Business Development, Sales, Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance functions while supporting multiple projects across commercial and government customers worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned customers.
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
- Manage customer expectations regarding scope, deliverables, timelines, risks, and project status.
- Prepare and facilitate customer reviews, status meetings, milestone reviews, and executive briefings.
- Escalate customer concerns and ensure timely resolution through the appropriate internal teams.

Project Lead Support

- Support Project Leads in planning, tracking, and coordinating customer-facing project activities.
- Ensure customer requirements are clearly documented, communicated, and understood by project teams.
- Assist Project Leads in maintaining project schedules, milestones, action logs, and risk registers.
- Monitor project progress against customer commitments and highlight deviations early.
- Coordinate cross-functional follow-up activities required to meet customer deliverables.
- Support the preparation of project reviews, gate reviews, progress reports, and management presentations.
- Create and own customer facing documents like Project Management Plan, Program specific Design Development and Verification Plan, etc. in accordance with ECSS or other space standards

Contract and Deliverable Management

- Maintain awareness of customer contractual requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and milestones.
- Track customer deliverables and ensure alignment between contractual obligations and project execution plans.
- Support change request management and ensure scope modifications are appropriately documented and communicated.
- Monitor customer milestone achievements and support associated documentation and reporting activities.
- Coordinate with Sales Operations, Finance, and Program teams regarding customer orders, invoicing milestones, and contractual deliverables.

Risk and Issue Management

- Assist Project Leads in identifying and tracking project risks, dependencies, and issues.
- Ensure customer-impacting risks are proactively communicated and mitigation plans are developed.
- Support issue resolution by coordinating actions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
- Provide early visibility of schedule, cost, or technical concerns that may affect customer commitments.

Reporting and Governance

- Maintain customer reporting metrics.
- Support weekly and monthly project reviews and executive reporting.
- Track customer actions, risks, and deliverables.
- Ensure proper documentation of customer communications, decisions, and commitments.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management and customer engagement processes.

What you bring with you

Required

- 3-7 years of experience in project management, customer project management, account delivery management, or program coordination within aerospace, satellite communications, telecommunications, high-tech manufacturing, or related industries.
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
- Experience working in cross-functional project environments involving Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams.
- Personal Experience working with ECSS or other space standards, its tailoring and excecution for organisations like ESA or related companies
- Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience coordinating multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to translate technical information into customer-friendly language.
- Strong presentation and reporting skills.
- Proficiency with project management tools and Microsoft Office applications.

Desired

- Experience in the aerospace, satellite, defense, or telecommunications industries
- Familiarity with customer deliverables, contractual milestones, and change management processes.
- Experience supporting product development or manufacturing projects.
- Knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
- Experience working in matrix organizations.
- Exposure to international customers and cross-cultural business environments.
- Working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP.

What we offer you

postings.title: Environmental Test Engineer

postings.title: Hardware Design Engineer – Radiation Testing (m/f/d)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Do you have a passion for electronics? Do you want to bring your multi-year experience to a dynamic company? Then you are exactly right for us! For our headquarters in Munich we are looking for you to start as soon as possible as a Hardware Design Engineer – Radiation Testing (m/f/d) full time.

What awaits you at Mynaric

Role Overview:

As a Hardware Design Engineer in the Radiation Team, you will assist with setting up and running tests on electronic components used in our optical communications terminal, helping us make sure everything works well even in the extreme conditions of space. You'll have the chance to advance your understanding of space technology, test hardware, and get hands-on experience with automation and programming. You’ll also make sure everything is built to meet industry standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Radiation Testing of Electronics: Work alongside radiation experts, senior electronic engineers, software developers and other team members to get familiar with the full detail of our cutting edge electronic designs for satellites. Use your knowledge to:

- Prepare for radiation test campaigns. Develop test strategies, methodology, setups and scripts to test components and subsystems under realistic operational conditions while they are exposed to radiation.
- Use test results to strongly influence improvement of our current designs to increase their resilience in radiation effects and meet our customer’s expectations. Use your knowledge and imagination to achieve such improvements in a cost effective way that aligns with Mynaric’s business plan.

Test Board Design: Design radiation test boards across a wide range of cutting edge electronics for radiation testing. Additionally, design support electronics that will assist in providing stimulus and in collecting measurements.

Automation Software:

- Python or LabView to automate bench instruments via SCPI (Standard Commands for Programmable Instruments) to control hardware and gather data.
- C programming for control of microcontroller development boards for test inputs and data collection.

Data Collection & Analysis: Further develop current methodologies for clear test data collection aiding easy analysis of the results.

Standards Compliance: Ensure all work follows IPC (Institute for Printed Circuits) standards and ECSS (European Cooperation for Space Standardization) guidelines.

Logistics: In collaboration with our current team manage the test campaign logistics, including final verification of setups, booking radiation facilities, travel and shipping of equipment.

Learning & Growth: Take part in training and development to build your skills and knowledge in radiation hardness and assurance.

Travel: Prepared to travel several times a year to facilities throughout Europe and the US.

What you bring with you

- BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics or similar.
- Minimum 3 years of experience in electronic hardware design. Brilliant candidates with less or no experience will be considered.
- Strong curiosity and willingness to expand in new fields of knowledge.
- Proficiency with schematic capture, PCB layout, circuit simulation. Experience in ECAD tools (preferable Altium Designer).
- Familiarity with bench instruments (oscilloscopes, various analyzers and power supplies) is a must.
- Knowledge of SCPI scripting language used in automation of tests: Python, LabView or equivalent.
- Basic statistics knowledge and ability to analyze captured data and derive conclusions.
- Driving personality that enjoys taking responsibility, exceeding expectations, working outside of one’s own comfort zone and brings a “can do” attitude.
- Ability to interface across disciplines to resolve technical, schedule and organizational matters.
- Pragmatic approach in tackling issues, ability to effectively create your own momentum and make things happen.
- Willingness to travel within Europe at least once a month, and in the US two or three times a year.
- Optional: Basic knowledge of C++ and FPGA programming workflow.
- Language Skills: Fluency in English, both written and spoken. German is a bonus,but not required.

What we offer you

Have you always wanted to wear your favorite space outfit to work? Then you are exactly the right fit for us! Forget the office politics and come and work with inspiring colleagues from all over the world as you embark on an incredible journey with Mynaric to work on unique and challenging projects and make a real contribution to the future of connectivity.

We offer you permanent employment, varied areas of responsibility, and attractive employee benefits. Mynaric is absolutely committed to being an equal opportunity employer so we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, sex, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

So if this sounds like the kind of place where you would like to work then apply today and be part of the company that is changing the world!

postings.title: Material Planner - Manufacturing (m/f/x)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven planner who thrives in fast-moving hardware manufacturing organizations, can read a BOM, question and challenge lead times, and relentlessly drives the plan to green. You ensure uninterrupted production by translating demand into timely, accurate material availability—from raw materials to finished goods—using ERP/MRP, tight supplier coordination, and proactive risk management. You are the control tower for material flow across engineering, supply chain, production, and quality.

What awaits you at Mynaric

- Own end-to-end material readiness for assigned product lines: plan, and track POs; expedite/defers as needed; prevent/resolve shortages in close coordination with Commodity Buyers.
- Convert demand (forecasts, production schedules, NPI builds) into executable supply plans in ERP/MRP; maintain accurate parameters (lead times, lot sizes, safety stocks, min/max).
- Identify long lead items and initiate advanced procurements of such items – providing the Advanced Material Demand if at-risk buys are authorized by upper management, and advocating for the AMDs when needed.
- Drive supplier performance (OTD, lead time adherence, risk mitigation); escalate and run recovery plans for late/at-risk parts.
- Manage BOM changes and engineering updates (ECNs/ECOs) to avoid BOM inaccuracy. Involve and flow down BOM changes to the Commodity Buyers.
- Support NPIs and ramp-ups: align evolving BOMs, proto/bridge builds, and capacity with operations and engineering.
- Optimize inventory (days of supply, turns) while meeting service levels; propose parameter changes and pull systems (Kanban/JIT) where appropriate.
- Monitor and communicate material status to stakeholders; run shortage/commit reports and daily meetings.
- Maintain clean master data and transact accurately ensuring system matches physical flow.
- Ensure that supplier selection is done by SCM as much as possible and not by engineering – getting involved with each Engineer and ensuring they are involved from the beginning of the supplier engagement.

What you bring with you

- Extensive experience in cross-functional project management between Engineering, Quality, Production, and Supply Chain teams
- Experience running meetings for material status in order to begin R&D production as well as Serial Production.
- Robust technical experience managing requirements discussions between Suppliers, Engineers, and Buyers – ability to learn to read any drawing
- Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet tools and keen attention to data accuracy and organization.
- Profound knowledge in ERP systems such as SAP S4/Hana, in combination with an MES system for Shopfloor execution. Comfortable with multi-level BOMs.
- Demonstrated supplier management and expediting experience; strong prioritization under time pressure.
- Proven record of preventing and recovering from shortages while meeting build schedules.
- Business Fluent in English, both written and spoken, round up your profile. German is a plus.

What we offer you

postings.title: Production Controller (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Du möchtest mehr als nur Zahlen reporten? Als Production Controller (m/f/d) agierst du als Finance Business Partner für Operations und Supply Chain. Mit deinem Verständnis für Produktkosten, COGS, BOM und Profitabilität identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktions- und Geschäftsprozesse.

What awaits you at Mynaric

- Du verantwortest das Product & Production Controlling für unsere High-Tech-Produkte und schaffst Transparenz über Kosten, Margen und Profitabilität entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
- Du analysierst und steuerst die Entwicklung von COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), Materialkosten, Fertigungskosten und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale zur nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Profitabilität.
- Du arbeitest eng mit Production, Supply Chain, und dem Projekt Management zusammen, um Kostenstrukturen zu verstehen und weiterzuentwickeln.
- Du verantwortest die Analyse und Validierung von Bill of Materials (BOM), Herstellkostenkalkulationen und Cost-Roll-ups und stellst die Nachvollziehbarkeit der Produktkosten sicher.
- Du analysierst Abweichungen zwischen Plan, Forecast und Ist sowie Kosten- und Margenentwicklungen und leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
- Du identifizierst Kostenrisiken und Volatilitäten in Materialpreisen, Lieferketten und Produktionsprozessen und unterstützt geeignete Gegenmaßnahmen.

postings.title: Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific (m/f/x)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Shape the Future of Global Connectivity
At Mynaric, we're building the optical fiber for the skies.
As a pioneer in laser communications, we develop cutting-edge technology that enables ultra-fast, secure, and reliable data transmission between satellites, aircraft, drones, and terrestrial platforms. Our solutions are helping shape the future of aerospace, defense, and global communications networks.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific to accelerate our growth across one of the world's most dynamic aerospace and defense markets.
This is more than a sales role.
You will be the driving force behind expanding Mynaric's presence across Asia-Pacific, developing strategic customer relationships, identifying major business opportunities, and transforming qualified prospects into long-term partnerships. You will engage directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, defense organizations, system integrators, and innovative commercial space companies that are shaping the future of connectivity.
Just as importantly, you will remain actively involved after contract award, working closely with our Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to ensure customer expectations, program execution, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the customer journey.
If you are energized by complex sales cycles, strategic customer engagement, international business growth, and working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and mission-critical programs, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What awaits you at Mynaric

Drive Growth Across Asia-Pacific
You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities across government, defense, aerospace, satellite, and commercial markets throughout the region.
By building a deep understanding of customer priorities, market trends, and competitive landscapes, you will position Mynaric's solutions to solve critical challenges and create long-term value for our customers.

Build Trusted Customer Relationships
You will develop strong relationships with key decision-makers, program leaders, procurement organizations, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand how Mynaric's technology can support their strategic and operational objectives while creating opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Partner with Customers Throughout the Entire Lifecycle
Unlike traditional sales roles, your involvement does not end at contract signature.
You will work closely with the Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to support successful program execution, facilitate customer communications, participate in program reviews, and ensure alignment between contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and customer expectations.
Your ability to maintain trust during execution will be critical in driving customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term partnerships.

Lead Complex Sales and Capture Activities
You will own opportunities from initial market engagement through qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and expansion.
Working alongside Sales Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, and Executive Leadership, you will develop winning strategies that differentiate Mynaric and maximize customer value.

Influence the Future of Our Business
As the voice of the customer within Mynaric, you will bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback back into the organization to shape product development, strategic decision-making, and future growth initiatives.

What you bring with you

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, strategic account management, or capture management within the aerospace, defense, satellite, communications, or high-technology sectors.
- Experience developing business within Asia-Pacific markets and navigating complex customer and government environments.
- Proven success leading multi-stakeholder sales campaigns from opportunity identification through contract award.
- Strong commercial acumen and track record of delivering measurable business growth.

Leadership & Collaboration

- Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, from engineers and program managers to C-level executives and government decision-makers.
- Experience working successfully in a matrix organization with cross-functional teams.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with project delivery teams while maintaining a strong customer focus.
- Natural relationship builder who thrives on creating trust, alignment, and long-term partnerships.

Personal Attributes

- Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and strong commercial instincts.
- Customer-centric and passionate about solving complex challenges.
- Confident communicator and presenter with excellent negotiation skills.
- Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving international environment.
- Collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions and cultures.

Education & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Business, or a related discipline.
- MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification is an advantage.
- Experience with CRM and pipeline management tools.
- Fluent English is essential; additional Asia-Pacific languages are highly desirable.
- Willingness to travel internationally up to 50% of working time.
